newsitem.title: UK: GNER offers discounted London-Scotland fare.
newsitem.headline: GNER offers discounted London-Scotland fare.

text.p: Britain's Great North Eastern Railway (GNER) said on Monday it had reduced the price of travel from London to Scotland to 19 stg.
GNER, the main intercity rail operator in eastern Britain, said the new single fare would be available on all GNER's 15 daily services from London's Kings Cross station to Scotland from January 5.
The new fare, which GNER claimed would undercut all scheduled air operators, would be available to Edinburgh, Motherwell and Glasgow.
A single 23 stg fare to Dundee, Aberdeen and Inverness is also being introduced, GNER said.
Tickets on new fares would have to be booked at least seven days ahead.
